claims.claim: Norfloxacin, a quinolone sharing the query's 4-oxo-3-carboxylic acid and N-ethyl core, has absolute oral bioavailability of 30-70% with typical means near 40% in humans.

Low oral bioavailability outcomes for lurtotecan (about 11%), dronedarone (about 15%), and eliglustat (8.6%) come from non-quinolone scaffolds with different low-F mechanisms such as lactone instability and first-pass metabolism.
Bumetanide, a polar acidic drug from a different scaffold, shows oral bioavailability of 74.8% with food, providing weak additional support for high F.
